input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

errors.what: first simulator run used 100 seeds, far too few for batch arrivals; k=4 counts looked 3-7 packs off the rule
errors.fix: post hoc paired diagnostic showed feedback and pad limits change nothing; rerun with 2,000/4,000 seeds and printed standard errors closed the gap to 1 pack; both runs reported in LOG

errors.what: simulator scan window too narrow in one case (85% k=4 returned None)
errors.fix: window moves up when no S passes; rerun

doc_friction.issue: plain `python3 -m pytest tests` in research/aerolog-scaling fails to import aerolog_scaling (needs PYTHONPATH=src); the project README/CI path is not stated where a run looks first

deviations.why: predictions fixed 100 simulator seeds; that proved too noisy to test a 1-pack claim
deviations.did: kept predictions unchanged, raised seeds to 2,000/4,000 with a dated note in the docstring and both runs' numbers in LOG.md
deviations.result: rule within 1 pack in all 8 cases; residual -0.003 for k=4 reported as unexplained

notes: Checks run locally: PYTHONPATH=src pytest tests (33 passed), paper/check_numbers.py all ok (5 new 6k checks), research/_homepage/build.py ok, research_live_links.py, check_md_links.py ok, programme_check ok, post frontmatter/links/similarity ok. Experiment runtime 197 s on 4 cores.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: derivation of an exact time-varying queueing tail, implementation, simulator validation and noise diagnosis, write-up: about two working days for a queueing researcher

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
